items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: I did an album like that for Arbors, which I really respect Mat Domber for encouraging me to do that

ctx.x: Any plans for recording coming up soon? You mentioned your own project.

Yeah. Well I’m doing another album for Arbors Jazz, which is kind of a mixture of, it’s mostly original music actually, and it’s music inspired by situations I’ve been in and it’s all instrumental of course, but it’s music that seems to be pretty conservative to me but it’s not exactly old jazz, it’s not exactly anything, it’s kind of mixture of things. I did an album like that for Arbors, which I really respect Mat Domber for encouraging me to do that, because it’s not exactly the kind of music he has, although…
Well it’s nice to be able to write your own stuff and have an outlet for it too, because someone should be writing tunes for the future.
